messages:
Marie: Quick heads-up — AtlanticWorks (Jordan) wants to onboard their open model AW-1 into our marketplace + offer Dedicated bundles. They say the model weights are 'open but with limited commercial redistribution'. Need legal + platform clarity before we map SKUs. :eyes:
Sam (Legal): Can you paste the exact license text Jordan shared? 'limited commercial redistribution' is vague — we need the clause.
Jordan (AtlanticWorks): pasted below — it's the license header we ship with the weights. happy to clarify: we want use in hosted services but block re-selling the raw weights as a product.
Jordan (AtlanticWorks): ```
Permissive Model License (PML) v1.0
- You may use, modify, and run the model for internal and hosted inference.
- You may NOT redistribute raw unaltered model weights for commercial resale without a separate agreement.
- Attribution required.
```
Lina (Engineering): From a serving perspective, hosting the trimmed/quantized variants on Dedicated or Hosted is fine. We will need a redistribution definition: does 'redistribute raw weights' include providing VM images with baked-in weights?
Sam (Legal): Good Q. Typically we'd treat baked-in images as redistribution unless weights are sufficiently transformed (e.g., tied to service that prevents extraction). We should ask for an explicit carve-out if they want Marketplace AI Images.
Dan (Product): Also need to confirm embargo / announce cadence. Marketing wants a joint launch. Jordan, do you have a launch window or embargo?
Jordan (AtlanticWorks): Targeting early June. We'd like co-announcement and marketplace listing same week. Embargo until then.
Alex (Platform): Ops question — will they host a copy in their own S3 or provide us a signed manifest? We need a canonical ingest path for validation, CVE scan, and checksum verification.
Jordan (AtlanticWorks): We'll provide an S3 read-only bucket and manifest + sha256. Example: s3://aw-models/aw1/manifest.json (will share IAM principal).
Marie: Action list starting from here: 1) Legal to confirm whether PML v1.0 is compatible with Marketplace redistribution / Dedicated bundles. 2) Platform to validate ingest + runtime constraints. 3) Partnerships to negotiate commercial redistribution carve-out for marketplace images. 4) Marketing to draft joint announcement timeline.
Sam (Legal): I'll flag two concerns: export classification (is AW-1 trained on restricted data?) and the 'no resale' clause — we need sample language to include in our partner contract and Marketplace Terms. Draft suggestion: "Partner grants Redwood a limited redistribution license to distribute runtime artifacts (optimized/quantized/bundled for inference) via Redwood Marketplace and Dedicated, provided no raw weight files are made downloadable." Thoughts?
Lina (Engineering): That wording works technically — we already distribute optimized artifacts that are not raw weights (we strip certain files and add integrity keys).
Jordan (AtlanticWorks): That should be acceptable — AW wants to avoid enterprises selling raw checkpoints. As long as end-users cannot easily extract the raw weights, we're good.
Sam (Legal): Cool. I will draft an amendment to the MSA and a simpler Marketplace addendum. Will need a sample of the AW build pipeline so we can specify 'non-extractable' in SOW.
Dan (Product): Marketing: can you hold draft co-announcement copy? We'll sync after legal signoff. Also need to decide on Marketplace SKU (hosted per-token vs dedicated reserved).
Marie: Jordan, please share: 1) full license file, 2) manifest + s3 read path, 3) any export-control questionnaires. Aim to get these by EOW.
Jordan (AtlanticWorks): Uploading them now. I'll DM the IAM principal.
deploybot: build-notifier: artifact scan completed for s3://aw-models/aw1/manifest.json — 0 critical vulns. :white_check_mark:
Alex (Platform): Once we have the manifest I'll run our checksum + extractability assessment (script below).
Alex (Platform): ```bash
# naive check: ensure no raw .bin blobs labelled 'checkpoint'
grep -Ri "checkpoint" manifest.json || echo "no obvious raw checkpoint"
```
Sam (Legal): Can we agree timeline: Legal draft by Thu EOD, Platform validation by Fri EOD, Partnerships to negotiate redistribution clause by next Tue?
Marie: That works. Sam, flag anything blocking and I'll escalate.
Jordan (AtlanticWorks): Thanks all. Appreciate the quick turnaround — we really want to line up the launch. :party_parrot:
Lina (Engineering): small note: we'll also want permission to serve quantized variants (int8) under the same license — add to the addendum.
Sam (Legal): Noted — will add explicit callout for 'derived runtime artifacts (including quantized variants and model shards)'.
Dan (Product): I'll schedule a 30m sync Wed to align on joint messaging and SKU mapping. Invite sent.
Marie: Great. I'll update the partnership tracker with owners. Ping me if legal needs anything for the clause language.
Jordan (AtlanticWorks): sending assets now. Thanks!
